name: Jujutsudle — guess characters and verify release date chronology

planSteps.description: Click the Jujutsudle navigation button with data-testid 'nav-jujutsudle' in the sidebar to open the minigame
Click the classic mode tab with data-testid 'tab-classic'
Type 'Megumi' into the search input with data-testid 'jujutsudle-search-input'
Click the guess button with data-testid 'jujutsudle-guess-button' to submit the guess
Verify a guess row with data-testid 'guess-row' appears in the table with data-testid 'guess-chrono-cell' showing formatted release date and chronological arrow
